scope: Retrospective methods control on the single known licensed OpenHands case. No future user data.
features: Frozen final normalized hidden state at each next-token position. Successful file contents plus EOS, old training response plus EOS. No prompt token is targeted.
parameterization: Add delta to untied output matrix only. Both controls have the same initial logits. Each example carries half the objective weight.
objective: Squared distance of logits to one-hot labels plus 0.01 times squared Frobenius norm of delta. No intercept.
direct: Solve the positive definite normal equation in float64.
bp: Autograd gradient descent on the identical convex objective, fixed 1/L step, at most 240 iterations or relative gradient norm at most 1e-8.
timing: One CPU thread, one untimed warm-up per arm, six repetitions alternating order; retain every sample. Fit time includes each method's own setup and stopping. Common feature extraction and per-arm cold starts reported separately.
score: Autoregressive greedy generation in separate processes from durable float32 weights on already known A and predefined old item. Measure byte exact or AST equivalence for A and digit zero for the old task. Single fixed hyperparameter setting, no tuning.
outcome_policy: Keep both results whatever the outcome. No promotion and no change to the independently frozen candidate.
